units.source_text: 千代子听说过“三月咬穗垂”这句话。

en.t: Chiyoko had heard the saying, "In March, they bite at hanging hems."

units.source_text: 就是说，只要穿着下摆破烂的和服在溪流中一站，小鳟鱼就会一拥而上，咬住穗垂（衣衫的破片）。

en.t: That is, if someone wearing a kimono with a ragged hem simply stood in a mountain stream, little trout would swarm over and bite at the dangling strips of cloth.

units.source_text: 春天竟能钓得这样多的小鳟鱼。

en.t: In spring, one could catch an astonishing number of little trout that way.
